title: Immunization Services Price and Payment Schedule
content:
Each Immunization Services vaccination carries a cash price per dose, which includes administration, and a set of payment markers: whether a Medicare patient's dose is billed to Medicare Part B or to the patient's Part D plan, whether an insured patient who meets the vaccine's recommendation pays nothing, and whether the dose can come from Vaccines for Children stock, up to what age and for what administration fee. Amounts are in US dollars.

## Schedule

| Vaccination | Cash price per dose (USD) | Billed to Medicare Part B for a Medicare patient | Billed to the Part D plan for a Medicare patient | Insured patient meeting the recommendation pays nothing | Vaccines for Children stock | Highest age for Vaccines for Children stock | Vaccines for Children administration fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination | 44.99 | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | 18 | 0.00 |
| Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination | 89.99 | Yes | No | Yes | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| COVID-19 Updated Vaccination | 199.99 | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | 18 | 0.00 |
| RSV Older Adult Vaccination | 329.99 | No | Yes | Yes | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination | 299.99 | Yes | No | Yes | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | 229.99 | No | Yes | Yes | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series | 109.99 | No | Yes | Yes | No | 0 | 0.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The cash price is per dose and includes administration.
2. For a Medicare patient, the Seasonal Influenza vaccinations, the COVID-19 Updated Vaccination and the Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination are marked for Medicare Part B; the RSV Older Adult Vaccination, the Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series and the Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series are marked for the patient's Part D plan.
3. Every vaccination carries the marker that an insured patient who meets the vaccine's recommendation pays nothing for the dose.
4. Only the Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination and the COVID-19 Updated Vaccination can be given from Vaccines for Children stock, for a child aged no more than 18, with an administration fee of 0.00.

## Reading the schedule

The cash price is read per vaccination and per dose: the Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination lists 89.99 against 44.99 for the Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination, and the RSV Older Adult Vaccination lists 329.99. The Vaccines for Children columns apply only where the stock marker shows Yes; a highest age of 0 goes with a No marker.
